# has coordinate matrix

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCoordinateMatrix`](gmeow-hasCoordinateMatrix.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCoordinateMatrix>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Specifies a transformation or projection matrix associated with a coordinate axis, a homogeneous 4×4 pose matrix combining translation and rotation, a general n-D coordinate matrix (e.g. latent vector, configuration-space joint angles) on a [`SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) instance, or a geocode identifier string on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) instance (treated as a 1×1 identifier matrix, [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md) | [`gmeow:Pose`](../classes/gmeow-Pose.md) | [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) | [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasCoordinateMatrix`](gmeow-hasCoordinateMatrix.md) from [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md) | [`gmeow:Pose`](../classes/gmeow-Pose.md) | [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) | [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
